quote.text: Le vent se lève !… il faut tenter de vivre !
quote.english: The wind is rising… we must try to live.

poem.text:
O poeta é um fingidor.
Finge tão completamente
Que chega a fingir que é dor
A dor que deveras sente.
poem.english:
The poet is a faker.
He fakes it so completely
that he fakes as pain
the pain he really feels.
poem.note: Pessoa published under seventy-two invented names, each with a biography and a handwriting. This one he signed himself.
poem.translator: translated for this page, not a published version

painting.title: Bermuda, Masts and Foliage
painting.note: a precisionist who treated factories and hulls as if they were still lifes. summers in provincetown and bermuda, winters in lancaster, and a long friendship with william carlos williams. he died at fifty-one; the pictures stayed sharp.
